_comment: Where the Loment Early Use sign-up POSTs to. This is the one place on the site that has to hand data to someone else: a static page cannot send mail, so the form posts to a form-to-email service with a plain HTML form. No script is loaded from anywhere — the origin rule forbids third-party JS, not a form action. Swap `endpoint` for the service's alias once it issues one, and the published address comes out of the page source.
